name: lit-bytes
description: Byte-sized tech news in your status bar while Claude Code thinks.

litBytes.enableCardSync.description: Opt in to syncing anonymous stats (a random ID and numeric counters only — never code, prompts, or AI responses) to power your live badge and weekly recap image.

litBytes.cardServiceUrl.description: Base URL of the deployed LIT Bytes cards worker (e.g. https://lit-bytes-cards.example.workers.dev). Leave empty to disable badge/recap features.
